detail.longDescription: Discovered Materials, a Y Combinator startup, is putting 1M USD in prizes behind five unsolved materials science problems for AI. Frontier lab models, given internet access and days of autonomous work, made little headway. The aim is to set goalposts so that progress in materials AI can be measured against. https:// techcrunch.com/2026/11/05/a-yc -startup-is-putting-1m-behind-five-unsolved-materials-science-problems-for-ai/ # AIagent # AI # GenAI # AIresearch
